# Kanban workflow

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask gen` from pmt_kanban::workflow::TABLE; do not edit. -->

Every status change on a board is one of these transitions. Anything else is refused with `illegal transition <from> → <to> for <actor>` (exit 75; HTTP 409 from the dashboard API).

| Operation | Actors | From | To | Guard |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| promote | dispatcher, user | `todo` | `ready` | all parents done/archived |
| demote | dispatcher, user, worker | `ready` | `todo` | a parent is open |
| claim | dispatcher, user | `ready` | `running` | all parents done/archived |
| reclaim | dispatcher, user | `running` | `ready` |  |
| give up | dispatcher | `running`, `ready` | `blocked` |  |
| block | worker | `running` | `blocked` | the actor's own open run |
| block | user | `triage`, `todo`, `ready`, `running`, `review` | `blocked` |  |
| block (dependency) | worker | `running` | `todo` | the actor's own open run |
| block (dependency) | user | `ready`, `running` | `todo` |  |
| block loop | worker | `running` | `triage` | the actor's own open run |
| block loop | user | `todo`, `ready`, `running`, `review` | `triage` |  |
| unblock | user | `blocked`, `scheduled` | `ready` | all parents done/archived |
| unblock | user | `blocked`, `scheduled` | `todo` | a parent is open |
| unblock | user | `blocked` | `review` |  |
| schedule | user | `todo`, `ready`, `running`, `blocked` | `scheduled` |  |
| schedule | worker | `running` | `scheduled` | the actor's own open run |
| wake | dispatcher | `scheduled` | `ready` | all parents done/archived |
| wake | dispatcher | `scheduled` | `todo` | a parent is open |
| complete | worker | `running` | `done` | completion gates |
| complete | worker | `running` | `review` | completion gates |
| complete | user | `todo`, `ready`, `running`, `blocked` | `done` | completion gates |
| complete | user | `running` | `review` | completion gates |
| request review | worker | `running` | `review` | the actor's own open run |
| request review | user | `running`, `ready` | `review` |  |
| approve | reviewer, user | `review` | `done` | all parents done/archived |
| request changes | reviewer, user | `review` | `todo` |  |
| archive | user | `triage`, `todo`, `scheduled`, `ready`, `running`, `blocked`, `review`, `done` | `archived` |  |
| restore | user | `archived` | `triage` |  |
| restore | user | `archived` | `todo` |  |
| restore | user | `archived` | `ready` | all parents done/archived |
| plan | user | `triage` | `todo` |  |
| plan | user | `todo` | `triage` |  |
| requeue | user | `done` | `ready` | all parents done/archived |
| reopen review | user | `review` | `ready` | all parents done/archived |
| reopen review | user | `review` | `todo` | a parent is open |
| specify | user, dispatcher | `triage` | `todo` |  |
